brand.name: Canopy
brand.product: Privacy-centric browser for Android and Linux
alt_taglines: A quiet place on the open web.

accent.role: toggles, progress, selected, focus, active tab

on_surface.role: primary text and icons on dark

rules.wordmark: CANOPY in Exo 2 Medium or SemiBold, tracking +80 to +120, title case only in body copy
rules.headings: Exo 2 Semibold, sentence case except product name

logo_system.primary_mark: Faceted helmet with living canopy growing from the crest
logo_system.app_icon: Radiating geometric leaves over a shield/helmet base
logo_system.glyph: Three leaves on a rounded shield — use below 32px
logo_system.full_emblem: Knight writing in a book atop locked cubes — marketing only, never UI chrome
logo_system.lockup: Mark left + CANOPY wordmark right, leaf in the O optional
